senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Said, declared.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having or had said, was saying.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, क्तवतु aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Killing animals in sacrifice, immolation of victims.
2 Killing, slaughter.
3 Sprinkling with water, &c.
4 A text to be repeated when animals are offered.
E.
प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel for sprinkling water, &c.
E.
प्रोक्षण, and पात्र a vessel, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sprinkled.
2 Killed, slaughtered.
3 Offered in sacrifice.
E.
प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्तो-लत्)
Flowing, issuing, coming out or up.
E.
प्र and उत् before शल to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Swelled, swoln.
E.
प्र, and उच्छून swelled.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
प्र and उत् before जस to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Leaving, quitting, letting go.
E.
प्र before उञ्झ to leave, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Abandoned, shunned, avoided.
E.
प्र before उज्झित left.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A spitting pot.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sewn or stitched.
2 Tied, strung.
3 Set, inlaid.
4 Impaled.
5 Joined, connected.
n. (-तं)
Cloth, clothes.
E.
प्र before वे to weave or sew, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
A parasol, a Catta, an umbrella.
E.
प्रोत cloth, उत् over, सादन a house.

m. (-लः)
A sort of palm tree.
E.
प्र and उत् above, फल fruit.

n. (-नं)
Contriving, device.
E.
प्र and उत् before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
Clearing away, getting rid of, expelling.
E.
प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Relinquished, left, given up.
2 Got rid of, ejected, expelled.
E.
प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Effort, exertion.
2 Stimulus, incitement.
E.
प्र before उत्साह effort.

m. (-कः)
The instigator or adviser of any act, or, in law, of any crime.
E.
प्रोत्साह with कन् added.

n. (-नं)
Instigating, exciting, stimulating.
E.
प्र and उत् before सह to bear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Incited, instigated, stimulated, encouraged.
E.
प्र and उत् before सह to bear, in the causal form, aff. क्त.

(ऋ) प्रोथृ r. 1st cl. (प्रोथति-ते)
1 To be able, adequate or competent.
2 To be complete or ample.
3 To destroy, to subdue or overpower.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Travelling, wayfaring, a traveller.
2 Notorious, famous.
3 Placed, fixed.
mn. (-थः-थं)
The nose of a horse or the tip of it.
m. (-थः)
1 The loins or hip.
2 Old clothes.
3 The embryo or fœtus.
E.
प्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. थक्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Resonant, sounding well.
2 Making a loud noise.
E.
प्र, and उद्वुष्ट sounded.

n. (णं)
Sounding or crying aloud.
E.
प्र and उत् before घुष to cry, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Breaking forth, (as seeds, &c.)
E.
प्र, and उद्भिन्न put forth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Towering, very lofty.
E.
प्र, and उन्नत high.

n. (-नं)
Filling.
E.
प्र before उम्भ to fill, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-त-ता-तं)
Filled.
E.
प्र before उम्भ to fill, क्त aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to cover.
E.
प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. and the vowel changed.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to cover.
E.
प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. the augment इ omitted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent.
2 Strong, robust.
E.
प्र and उत् before लाघ to be able, क्त aff.

mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्)
Marking, making lines, scratches, &c.
E.
प्र and उल्लिख to mark, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Scratching, marking, drawing lines or marks.
E.
प्र and उत् before लिख to write, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-षः)
Burning.
E.
प्रुष to burn, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Abroad, absent, away from home, sojourning in another country.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त.

f. (-का)
A woman whose husband is absent.
E.
प्रोषित abroad, भर्तृ a husband, aff. कन् and टाप्.

n. (-णं)
Dying in a foreign country.
E.
प्रोषित absent, and मरण dying.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Strange, a stranger, a sojourner.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, क्तवतु aff.

mf. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी)
A sort of carp, (Cyprinus Pausius, HAM.)
m. (ष्ठः)
An ox.
E.
प्र before उष to burn, aff. थन्.

f. (-दा)
One of the constellations, the twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh, containing stars in the wing of Pegasus: see माद्रपदा.
E.
प्रोष्ठ here said to mean an ox, and पद a foot.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Born under the sign Proṣṭha padā.
E.
प्रोष्ठपद, and अण् aff. in this sense; in any other, the form is प्रोष्ठपद.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Skilful, clever.
2 Logical, reasoning, a reasoner, a disputant.
m. (-हः)
1 An elephant's foot.
2 A joint, a knot.
3 The ancle of an elephant.
E.
प्र before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be reasoned or argued.
E.
प्र before ऊह to reason, अनीयर् aff.
